C0182.title: High School Student Recruits Apprentices to Extort Merchants: "Professional Bad Review" Gang Operation
C0182.summary: Since 2020, Zhang, a student at a vocational college in Jiangxi, exploited e-commerce platform rules by fabricating product-quality problems with edited images, maliciously seeking compensation from merchants, and teaching extortion scripts and operating procedures to others. The “Big Pig Group” behind him had more than 30 core members and recruited over 400 apprentices, charging apprenticeship fees from 588 to 1,288 yuan and making nearly 300,000 yuan in illegal gains. Guangzhou Nansha police cracked the case in 2021, and many participants were students born after 2000.
